elements_selected.content: Write unit and integration tests for P1 features: TEST-042 (implicit section grounding), TEST-043 (explicit source grounding), TEST-044 (drift detection), TEST-045 (durable provenance). For TEST-042: test SPL in Section A is grounded only in Section A leaves; test SPL before first heading uses preamble; test subsection creates narrower context. For TEST-043: test same-file ^block-id grounding, cross-file [[Page^block-id]] grounding, multiple sources (MetaValue::List), broken ^block-id error, broken cross-file page error. For TEST-044: test section drift detection when prose edited; test explicit grounding drift; test no drift when SPL itself changed; test no drift when nothing changed; test --fail-on warning exit code. For TEST-045: test provenance includes grounding.fresh true; test fresh false with warning when section edited after build. Write as integration tests using tempfile vaults with realistic content.
